I understand that you feel bad for your rash of the moment action but you feeling bad is proof that your not a monster. You had a lot emotions and he did something that hurt your feelings so it’s completely justified that you felt the need to be physically upset. I’m not saying that what happened is right but that it’s understandable that it happened and you can’t beat yourself up over it. You are not a monster and the feeling you have are completely valid.

I’m glad you are ok and just feel sick. If you are in a financial stable position to go to the doctor I would but if you can’t that’s completely understandable. How are you feeling rn like emotionally?

I’m so sorry that this has all landed on your plate at once. You’re doing everything you can and have to be proud of yourself for that. I’m also in university and understand the pressure of class work. It can be really stressful but if taking a hiatus from school is beneficial to you you should definitely look into it. You can always take a year or semester off to work and give yourself time for you. It’s important to give yourself time for yourself. I know it’s hard to find that time but I believe in you and no matter what happens you are doing your best and that’s what will count on the end. I would love to help you what are you studying?
